model.reasoning: Primary method (software_internet playbook): a segment driver build over 3 years valued with horizon multiples. FoA revenue = FY2025 ad revenue x impressions index x price-per-ad index + FoA other revenue; FoA EBIT = revenue x GAAP margin; RL EBIT = -RL loss; capex from the driver. The set is valued on two legs: P/E 18.5x on core NTM GAAP EPS ex RL (0.45) and a SOTP with FoA at 15.5x NTM EBIT (0.55). RL is valued once as a -$53B venture (playbook venture rule), and adjustments cover litigation (-$39.4B expected) and investments (+$24.5B). Leg weights: no blend-weight study exists for this choice. 0.45/0.55 sits inside the forecasters' own ranges (P/E 0.35-0.50, SOTP 0.40-0.55), and the forward-P/E evidence (Liu, Nissim & Thomas 2002; dcf_bias ladder) supports a large P/E weight. The EV/EBITDA leg (forecaster mean weight 0.13) is dropped because consolidated EBITDA capitalises RL losses a second time. Dropping it moves the research target (12m) by under 1%. Cross-checks: the research target (12m) of $659.48 is 20.3x consolidated FY2027 EPS of ~$31.3 and 17.8x core NTM EPS of $36.9. META trades at 18.9x FY2027 consensus EPS ($33.93, Nasdaq.com/Zacks snapshot 2026-10-26, src 19). The peer-median 23.7x on consensus (mixed provider EPS basis) would give ~$804 and is not used. Per-share figures are per CURRENT pre-split share (today's Class A share plus the Class C share it receives in the dividend payable after 2027-01-19; 8-K 2026-10-21); EV is unchanged. After year 3 the multiple implies ~10% revenue growth in 2029-31, with capex easing from ~66% toward ~35-40% of revenue and FoA margins recovering to the high 30s. Labelled estimates from non-filing evidence: WARC social ad growth (medium confidence; drives price per ad; variant: A3 price path -$18/share); NM payout share of 40% (low; variants 20% / 60% = +/-$1.9/share, full $25B paid -$5.8/share); RL persistence 30% (low; A2's 40% at 13x = -$16/share); foa_other Muse/subscriptions (low; +/-$3/share). Guided metrics: Q4-26 revenue: guide $73-76B, record-adjusted $77.5B, ours $75.9B, inside (top half). FY2026 total expenses: guide $175-179B, record-adjusted $174.5B, ours $177.1B, inside (midpoint). FY2026 capex: guide $135-145B, record-adjusted $161.8B (first-guide record, which does not apply this late), ours $141B, inside. FY2027 RL loss: guide ~$15B, record-adjusted $14.5B, ours $15.0B, inside. FY2027 revenue: no guide and no openable dated revenue consensus; ours $308.0B. FY2027 EPS ~$31.3 is 7.8% below the $33.93 consensus because the D&A follows the AI capex file's capex, above street. Drivers reproduce the FY2025 base exactly (FoA $198,759M; residual 0.0%); driven share of revenue 98.9%. Not driver-linked: RL venture value, litigation, investments, the D&A path. Update 2026-10-27 (equity raise, no new print or guide): only the capital structure moved. Forward sale (pricing term sheet, upsized to $25.0B): +40M shares and +$24.9B cash at the horizon (physical settlement by 2027-11-19, inside the NTM window). Mandatory convertible: $12.5B preferred, 6.50%, converts ~2029-08-15 between 1.3620 and 1.6000 shares per preferred ($625.00-$734.21): deducted as balance.preferred $12,662.5M (incl. accrued dividend) on the SOTP leg and as $812.5M NTM dividends in EPS to common on the P/E leg; cash in net debt; conversion shares not added (inside the band 19.1M shares at ~$656 = the same $12.5B claim).
